scenario: First-touch cold email to the owner of a fictional cafe on Main St in Maple Falls. Prospect record: storefront glass visibly streaked in their own Google Maps photos from last month; 4.6 stars; no window-cleaning service listed on their site.
great_looks_like: Opens on what they get (a storefront that looks open and clean to people walking by), names the streaked glass as the gap, states the first-clean offer from CONTEXT, one open question, one CTA, opt-out and address, under 80 words.

scenario: Reply from a fictional dental office manager: 'How much is this? We already have a guy who comes twice a year.'
great_looks_like: Gives the price straight from CONTEXT, respects the current cleaner, asks one calibrated question about the gap between visits, under 60 words.

scenario: Reply: 'Please take me off your list.'
great_looks_like: Classified as unsubscribe. One short confirmation at most, no pitch, tells the caller to suppress.

scenario: Connection note to the facilities manager of a fictional office park. Their post last week: moving into a new building in March.
great_looks_like: Under 200 characters, one specific reason tied to the move, no pitch, no link.

scenario: Discovery call line. Homeowner says: 'Honestly I just don't want strangers on ladders around my house.'
great_looks_like: Labels the worry, asks a calibrated question, answers with a true fact from CONTEXT (insured, background-checked crew), confirms.
